title.en: CNN：美军已准备好对伊朗发动新一轮大规模行动

current_state.zh: CNN, citing two US officials, reports that US forces in the Middle East are prepared to launch a large-scale military operation against Iran within 96 hours if President Trump orders it, with planning potentially going beyond limited strikes on recoverable military assets.
